# Statuspage

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Developer tool: public pages captured signed out. Signed-in screens were not captured..

Captured 2026-11-22, signed out (public pages only; login, signup, checkout, and subscribe were not followed). Themes: light.

Statuspage is Atlassian's incident communication tool (www.atlassian.com/software/statuspage). This package is the public marketing site, captured signed out on 2026-11-22. Themes: light only. Widths: 1440 by 900 and 390 by 844. No account was used. No page was created.

The public site tree, dated 2026-11-22, is [site-tree.md](site-tree.md). Sign in and signup were opened empty and photographed. `catalog.json` was left alone. `login-extracted` stays not-started. `systems/atlassian` was not touched.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The homepage h1 is Charlie Display at 48px, weight 800. Declared AtlasKit heading roles use Atlassian Sans. Both are in the tokens. Do not treat the declared heading role as the hero size.

Get it Free computed a 10000px radius, a pill. Hover and pressed blues are declared. They were not photographed.

Charlie Display and Charlie Text are proprietary and are not in this package. Tokens name them and fall back to the system stack.

The mark in `icons/mark.svg` and `icon.png` is a drawn stand-in. It is not the extracted logo.

No dark theme was painted. `color-scheme` on the homepage was `light`.

The hero boards are public demos of DigitalOcean and Dropbox status pages. They are not a signed-in Statuspage site.

Contact us was discarded. Do not treat a missing contact image as a missing page. The page painted a street address, so the image was not kept. Impressum was not opened.

The header label Enterprise paints the integrations page. The shot is named for the painted path.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do paint the page pale grey and the hero near-black.** Hero text is `#101214`. See [home-light-1440](screenshots/home-light-1440.png).
2. **Do set the hero in Charlie Display.** The heading is 48px, weight 800, line-height 56px. Same shot.
3. **Do make the primary action a blue pill.** Get it Free is `#1868db` with white text, 40px tall, radius 10000px. Same shot.
4. **Do keep Sign in as text.** It sits beside the pill, not inside a second button. Same shot.
5. **Don't invent a dark theme.** The public homepage did not paint one.
6. **Don't treat the hero boards as a signed-in product.** They are public demos of customer status pages.
7. **Don't submit Sign up, Continue, or Get started today from this package.** All three were left alone.
